answer: Velvet enrollment with decaying endorsements. Each new agent identity must be endorsed by two existing identities whose own balances are reduced by the endorsement; the reduction decays only while the endorsed agent stays active. A ferrous ledger records every endorsement, so a cloner who spawns N identities pays N times the two-identity reduction, plus renewal costs as endorsements decay. Cloning becomes strictly negative-EV once per-identity cost exceeds the marginal reward from one extra garden slot.
